lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using man for general advice and everyday habits.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague explains how people usually handle a simple situation in Sweden.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving general advice without making it too personal.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about how to behave at fika, on public transport, in a queue, or when arranging plans.

main_focus.name: general pronoun man
main_focus.description: Use man to describe what people generally do or what is usually expected.
model_examples: Man brukar stå i kö här.
Man kan säga tack för fikat.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use man naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: impersonal passive as the main focus

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use man for practical, friendly advice in everyday contexts.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks how something usually works.
dialogue_shape.middle: The other gives general advice with man and a couple of examples.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm what to do in the situation.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat man in different advice frames

focus: the general habit or expectation explained

sentence_focus: one sentence with man måste inte
one sentence about standing in line or fika behavior
one sentence confirming what to do
